top: For there is one God, and one mediator
bottom: between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

top: Study to shew thyself approved unto God,
bottom: a workman that needeth not to be ashamed...

top: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course,
But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower
bottom: than the angels... crowned with glory and honour...

top: For the word of God is quick, and powerful,
bottom: and sharper than any twoedged sword...

top: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith
bottom: without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

top: How much more shall the blood of Christ...
bottom: purge your conscience... to serve the living God?
